RECON (unblacked-loveless-toad / mechanism ratchet): template is scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py
(737 lines, NOT 644 as ticket said). Modes --check/--update-stale/--lock mutually exclusive+required;
baseline {schema_version:1, ceilings:{key:int}}; compare() 4 buckets new/increased/active/stale,
has_regression = new or increased; --check prints 'active=N new=N increased=N stale=N'.
Live counts of the 7 kinds on current tree: lock 26 (12 classes + 14 .lock filenames), REBAR_* env
132, config keys 103 (16 sections via rebar._config_sections._SECTIONS), ci_gate 29 check_*.py
(23 lint-wired) + 251 workflow run: steps, autouse fixtures 145, tests/_*.py helpers 19,
feature flags 27 (boolean config keys; repo has NO dedicated flag registry).
Reuse: gen_env_registry.scan(), _config_sections._SECTIONS, tests/_tree_scan.parsed_python_files,
rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write. Insertion point: make lint right after check_complexity_baseline.
Constraints: .github/module-size-limit.txt=800, ruff mccabe max-complexity=15.

DEVIATIONS from ticket file_impact, both following actual repo precedent (recorded for the
residual-gap sweep):
 1. tests live at tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py NOT tests/scripts/test_check_mechanism_delta.py
    — the direct precedent test_complexity_baseline.py is in tests/unit/; tests/scripts/ is
    bridge/reconciler-focused.
 2. dropping --lock mode (~135 LOC): complexity gate needs it only because its limit is
    administrator-locked; the mechanism baseline is not. Keeps the package inside the LOC cap.
 3. decomposing into scripts/_mechanism_delta/ package (baseline/compare/detect_code/detect_config/
    detect_ci) — 7 detectors in one file breaks both the 800 cap and complexity 15.

CROSS-LEAF NOTE: rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write ALREADY EXISTS — relevant to
silverish-parodic-quoll's unique-write helper; must not duplicate it.
